basics.name: Ram Krishna Sharma
basics.label: Postdoctoral Research Associate
basics.summary: Particle physicist at Purdue University working on Higgs physics, vector boson scattering, and precision electroweak measurements at the LHC. Research spans collider-physics analysis, detector development (GEM, HGCAL), and scientific software within the CMS Collaboration.

work.name: Purdue University
work.summary: Higgs boson physics, high-mass Higgs searches, and resonant di-Higgs production within CMS.
highlights: Lead analyst for Higgs boson decay to muon pairs (H→μμ).
Main analyzer and contact person for high-mass Higgs search in ZZ→2l2q and 2l2ν (HIG-23-001).
Leading resonant Higgs pair search in WWγγ final state (B2G-24-010).
Assessing and improving high-pT muon performance.

work.name: IHEP Beijing and CERN
work.summary: Higgs physics analyses, EGamma HLT coordination, and detector R&D within CMS.
highlights: Main analyzer for non-resonant HH→WWγγ (fully hadronic channel); CMS-PAS-HIG-21-014.
Contributed to H→4l differential cross-section measurements; introduced n-jettiness observable.
Helped establish first CMS evidence for semileptonic WW/WZ vector boson scattering (4.4σ).
HGCAL sensor studies for HL-LHC upgrade.
Led CPPF data quality monitoring for CMS Level-1 trigger online DQM.

work.name: CMS Collaboration
highlights: Optimized electron and photon HLT energy regression, identification, isolation, and data-to-simulation scale factors for Run-3.

work.name: University of Delhi and CERN
highlights: Sole analyst for anomalous EW production search in semileptonic diboson final states, setting world-leading aQGC limits.
Contributed to CMS GE1/1 GEM upgrade: assembly, characterisation, beam tests, and alignment studies.
Corresponding author on first GEM foils produced in India.

publications.name: Stairway to discovery: A report on the CMS programme of cross section measurements from millibarns to femtobarns
